title: Facebook Ads in Cameroon: How to Run Campaigns That Actually Work
author: Slim Biz
excerpt: Facebook Ads in Cameroon can deliver powerful results when done right. Learn how to set up, target, and optimize your campaigns to reach Cameroonian customers and grow your business.
body:
Facebook is the most used social media platform in Cameroon. With millions of active Cameroonian users on Facebook and Instagram every day, Facebook Ads represent one of the most powerful and affordable tools available to any business looking to grow in this market.

But running Facebook Ads without a strategy is money wasted. This guide explains everything you need to know to run Facebook Ads in Cameroon that deliver real results.

Why Facebook Ads Work in Cameroon

Cameroonians spend a significant amount of time on Facebook every day — browsing news, watching videos, following brands, and discovering new businesses. Unlike traditional advertising such as TV or billboards, Facebook Ads allow you to reach a very specific audience based on location, age, interests, and behavior.

You can target people in Douala, Yaoundé, Bafoussam, or any other city. You can target by language — French or English. You can reach people who are interested in specific topics relevant to your business. And you can start with a budget as low as 5,000 FCFA per day.

Setting Up Facebook Ads for Your Cameroonian Business

The first step is creating a Facebook Business Page if you do not already have one. Your page needs to look professional — a clear profile photo, cover image, complete contact information, and regular posts showing your products or services.

Next, you need a Facebook Ads Manager account. This is where you create, manage, and monitor all your campaigns. You will need a payment method — a Visa or Mastercard credit or debit card works. Some businesses use virtual cards from platforms like Wave or Orange Money linked international cards.

Choosing the Right Campaign Objective

Facebook offers many campaign objectives. The most useful for Cameroonian businesses are: Awareness (to get more people to know your brand), Traffic (to send people to your website or WhatsApp), Leads (to collect phone numbers and emails), and Sales (to drive direct purchases).

For most small businesses in Cameroon, starting with a Traffic or Leads campaign works best. You can drive people directly to your WhatsApp number and convert them through conversation.

Targeting the Right Audience in Cameroon

This is where most businesses make mistakes. Targeting too broadly wastes budget. Targeting too narrowly limits reach. The right balance depends on your business.

For a restaurant in Douala: target people aged 18-45, located within 10km of your restaurant, interested in food, dining, and going out. For a fashion boutique in Yaoundé: target women aged 18-35, interested in fashion, beauty, and lifestyle. For a professional service: target business owners and professionals in your city.

Always exclude audiences who have already converted so you are not showing ads to existing customers.

Creating Ads That Stop the Scroll

In a crowded Facebook feed, your ad has less than two seconds to capture attention. Use high-quality images or short videos that show your product or service clearly. Write headlines that speak directly to a problem or desire your target customer has. Always include a clear call to action: Contact Us on WhatsApp, Order Now, Learn More.

For Cameroonian audiences, ads in French tend to perform better for reaching the broader population. English works well for targeting professional and younger urban demographics.

How Much Do Facebook Ads Cost in Cameroon?

Facebook Ads in Cameroon are relatively affordable compared to European or American markets. A budget of 50,000 to 150,000 FCFA per month can generate significant reach and results for a local business. The cost per result depends on your audience, creative quality, and campaign optimization.
